quest.title: In a New Light
quest.description: You learn of the culprit's name from the criminals Navia gathered. However, that person is currently at the Fortress of Meropide. It looks like you'll have to make a trip down there...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x550, Primogem x60, Mora x38100, Guide to Equity x5, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

chapter.title: The Remains of the Past Day

talks.objective: Go to the Fortress of Meropide

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Fortress of Meropide, dear esteemed guests.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, and a greeting from none other than the Duke himself! Guess we've made a name for ourselves at this place, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: This isn't anything new. I figured you had important matters to discuss when the two of you — not to mention the Chief Justice — showed up.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Let us assume we've gone through the pleasantries and cut right to the chase.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Wriothesley about the threat letter Kiara received...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I do remember a thing or two about Domenico. He once attempted to round up the other inmates and instigate a protest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who does this guy think he is!? Paimon hopes nothing came of it.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: He "once attempted to," I said, meaning that it was over before it even started. And now he's threatening Melusines, is he?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: ...To be honest, Domenico doesn't seem like much of a conspirator. The fact that the three of you bothered to personally investigate raises a flag... Is there something else going on behind the scenes here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, he's got the same concerns we do!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I am concerned about this incident because something similar has occurred in the past. I wish to meet Domenico in person and have my questions answered.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: That's an easy one. Let me think, I think he's at...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Did I hear someone say "Melusine"? What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sigewinne!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A Melusine named Kiara received a threatening letter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, and we're investigating! The person who threatened her seems to be held imprisoned here.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Really? Is Kiara gonna be okay?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: There's no need to worry. Clorinde is protecting her as we speak.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Oh, that's great. But if the criminal's still... Is there anything you can do about this?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Ah, Head Nurse, do you require me to personally deal with the criminal?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Wriothesley.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Okay, I get it. I'll bring Domenico to you — that's your only demand, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Think of it as more of a humble request. I am here on my own accord, not to formally transfer a criminal for trial. I urge you to set aside any concerns.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Thanks for the trouble. Consider me in your debt.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... If Paimon were the Duke, Paimon would take this chance to ask for something really important!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Well, were I still a criminal, I'd probably ask for a lighter sentence — but I'm sure Monsieur Neuvillette would reject that.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: But enough jokes. I'll look for Domenico and bring him to you.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Make yourselves at home. Our dear Head Nurse has mentioned you quite a few times, so I'm sure she has a lot to say.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Please rest here for a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Oh, and would anyone like anything to drink?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mm, Paimon's not that thirsty, but thanks anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Thirst is a warning sign that you're dehydrated, which means you have to drink up even before that.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I'll bring you some tea. I'm sure you'll have a lot to talk about.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Typical Sigewinne, concerned about everyone's health as always...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why aren't you two saying anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The criminals we passed by earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: You noticed them too? The badges they wore on their chests looked quite familiar.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Familiar? Uh, Paimon didn't even realize they were wearing them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But if the both of you say so, let's go ask them about it!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: That's not a bad idea. I'll stay here and wait for news from you.

choices.text: You're not exactly a sight for sore eyes around here.

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: Anything you need?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The badge you're wearing...

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: Oh, this? Are you interested in joining the Mutual Aid Network?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: We have a very long history, going back as far as four hundred years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: We have never had many members throughout our history, nor do we have much of a reputation... But everyone treats each other like family.

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: Helping each other is our purpose. At the same time, we seek to maintain just dealings as much as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like a pretty neat organization!

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: Haha, all we want is to defend ourselves. None of us have ever committed serious crimes, and we're not especially powerful either. We're at a natural disadvantage here in the Fortress.

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: But people won't give us a hard time if we stick together.

dialogues.speaker: Millereau
dialogues.text: Interested in joining the Mutual Aid Network?

dialogues.speaker: Millereau
dialogues.text: If you'd like to learn more, here's our flyer.

dialogues.speaker: Millereau
dialogues.text: Our slogan may have evolved over the centuries, but our goal has remained unchanged.

dialogues.speaker: Millereau
dialogues.text: Here, this book is for you. You're welcome to come and sign up anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Auriol
dialogues.text: Hmm... You two look kinda familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The badge you're wearing...

dialogues.speaker: Auriol
dialogues.text: It's the symbol of the Mutual Aid Network, designed by our first president.

dialogues.speaker: Auriol
dialogues.text: From what I've heard, it's based on something called a Medal of Peace. I've never seen one of those medals for myself, though.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Medal of Peace?

dialogues.speaker: Auriol
dialogues.text: The first president of our network was an amazing person. Powerful as he was, he never used his strength against anyone. He encouraged the weaker criminals to stick together and look out for each other.

dialogues.speaker: Auriol
dialogues.text: ...All of us have a lot of respect for him.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I place great trust in Wriothesley, so I rarely visit the Fortress of Meropide. However, exceptional circumstances call for exceptional measures... I hope I didn't cause him too much trouble.

talks.objective: Inform Neuvillette of your investigation results

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Did you manage to gather any intel?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The people who wore the badges belong to an organization called the Mutual Aid Network.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: According to them, the badge's design was inspired by the Medal of Peace. Have you seen any of those before?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I personally crafted two of them myself. They were awarded to Carole and Vautrin.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Carole's medal was destroyed in a fire. The only one that remained should belong to Vautrin.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So the network was inspired by...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette, His Grace has requested your presence in his office. He's found Domenico.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: ...Alright. Let us talk to him first and get to the bottom of this situation.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Allow me to introduce this... fine gentleman, Domenico.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Why don't you explain everything to him?

dialogues.speaker: Domenico
dialogues.text: N—Neuvillette!?

dialogues.speaker: Domenico
dialogues.text: What do you want? What are you gonna do, kill me?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Calm down. I merely wanted to ask you a few questions.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Was it your idea to send that letter to a Melusine?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Esseim has already confessed, so there really isn't any need to keep hiding.

dialogues.speaker: Domenico
dialogues.text: That idiot... I can't believe I trusted him!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Let me ask this another way: It was your idea to send that threat letter, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Domenico
dialogues.text: ...Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Who is pulling your strings?

dialogues.speaker: Domenico
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.speaker: Domenico
dialogues.text: Y—You're not trying to frame me for something I haven't done, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: It's best if you realize the gravity of your situation. The Chief Justice of Fontaine has been personally investigating your case.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I assume your previous attempt to incite unrest at the Fortress of Meropide has something to do with this as well.

dialogues.speaker: Domenico
dialogues.text: I... I admit I acted on impulse... I'll tell you the truth... but before that, you must ensure my safety.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I can do that.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: You see? We're all reasonable people here.

dialogues.speaker: Domenico
dialogues.text: I only intended to do some small business at first. Someone contacted me about delivering some goods and promised me a generous sum of Mora in return.

dialogues.speaker: Domenico
dialogues.text: After making a few trips, I was suddenly approached by the Marechaussee Phantom... They accused me of smuggling prohibited items, and I was put on trial—

dialogues.speaker: Domenico
dialogues.text: But I refuse to accept any of that. The ignorant can be rightfully absolved from guilt, right? Well, I suspect that someone got me locked up here so they could get their hands on my goods...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And then you decided to take revenge on the Melusines... over that?

choices.text: Ignorance is not an excuse, by the way.

response.speaker: Domenico
response.text: My initial target was Neuvillette. Everyone in the Fortress of Meropide was declared guilty by him, after all, so they must more or less hold a grudge against him, right? If I could get them to strike back...

response.speaker: Domenico
response.text: But for some reason, no one wanted to team up with me. That... Mutual Aid Network, in particular. What did those nobodies even gain from trying to challenge me, seriously...

response.speaker: Domenico
response.text: In the end, I had to redirect my focus onto Melusines to salvage things.

response.speaker: Domenico
response.text: I recalled that Kiara was the one who confiscated my goods for inspection, so I asked one of the more approachable guards to send a letter, claiming that I meant to contact my family...

response.speaker: Domenico
response.text: But the letter was in fact addressed to Esseim. I requested that he write a threat letter to Kiara and force her to resign from the Marechaussee Phantom...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Am I to assume that the claims you've made are your own thoughts? Have you been in contact with any suspicious people recently?

response.speaker: Domenico
response.text: No.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Is it true that all members involved in the smuggling scandal have been caught?

response.speaker: Domenico
response.text: Yes... and that's all I know.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Sigewinne, please take him back to the detention center. I'll deal with him later.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: So, Monsieur Neuvillette, you were concerned that there might be a shadowy faction looking to capitalize on the delicate situation with the Melusines to stir up greater chaos?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Yes. I experienced a similar incident in the past, so I had to be prepared for any possibility.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And how long ago was this incident?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: More than four hundred years.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: You might be overthinking this.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Time can change a lot of things. Everything's different now.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: What do you mean?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Four hundred years ago, you and the Melusines you brought to Fontaine were the outliers in society.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: But in the present day, if someone were to threaten the safety of the Melusines, people wouldn't just sit back and do nothing. I trust that they would make different choices from before.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! We saw lots of people standing up for Melusines on our way back to the Palais Mermonia!

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Monsieur Neuvillette, the Melusines are a species you introduced to Fontaine. How the public treats them is also reflective of their attitude towards you.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: When people refused to place their trust in Melusines, it was because they were still on the fence about you — their unfamiliar Chief Justice.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: For almost five hundred years, you've conducted every trial with impartiality. You made the right judgment each time regardless of whatever nonsense went on.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: People no longer have any reservations about you and even consider you a symbol of the law.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Right now, your every decision will impact all of Fontaine. In other words, you've gradually transformed the whole nation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon gets it now. No wonder no one wanted to join forces with Domenico...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Tragedies like that won't ever happen again.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I am undeserving of such high compliments. From my perspective, I have simply been fulfilling my duties.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: It isn't anything special or worthy of praise. I'm simply fulfilling the promises I've made and searching for answers through my judgments.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: It's unnecessary to hold me in such high regard... The complexity of human emotions and willpower far exceed those of mine. As a matter of fact, I believe that you are the ones who deserve my respect.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Ah, there's no need to be so modest. The current state of affairs says it all.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: You're no longer that outsider you were before. Even if you wished to investigate something on your own, many would take the initiative to lend you a hand.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I must say that you've made a fair point.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Thank you for clearing my doubts. Now that the case has been settled, I should get going.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? You're leaving?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And so soon, too? Why not stay for a cup of tea?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Thank you for the offer, but I know how this place works all too well.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: While some are here to redeem themselves, there will inevitably be those who harbor resentment towards me.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: The less time I spend here, the better. My presence could very well result in an unwanted disturbance.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: In that case, I'll have to insist. I still have two more things to say.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Please go ahead.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: The first is about the guard who helped Domenico send that letter...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Ah, I know of what you speak.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: The guard was indeed deployed from the Palais Mermonia's staff. However, as I mentioned earlier, I visited today on personal business. Therefore, I leave that matter in your hands.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Well, that makes things a lot easier.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're not going to...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Hey now, don't let your imagination run wild.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Those from up there have a tendency to sympathize with others. However, down here, such thoughts will put you at high risk.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I'll have a chat with the guard and remind him to take precautions in the future.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I see no issues with that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great, that's one thing out of the way! What's the other thing you wanted to say?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: The other thing was born from my own sense of curiosity. Now, I've heard that you investigated the Mutual Aid Network. Is that right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep. Neuvillette thought their badges looked familiar...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I noticed the small gang as well, when I first took over the Fortress of Meropide. They were not great in number, but every member always made sure to stand up for what was right.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I've looked into their founder — Vautrin — who once stood trial and was sentenced to imprisonment in the Fortress.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: According to existing documentation, Vautrin remained disciplined throughout his imprisonment. He had never once engaged in physical or verbal aggression.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: In other words, how he presented himself in prison was very different from his behavior in court.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: What?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Doesn't he hate Neuvillette?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: During his trial, I could sense that his feelings were complicated. He appeared to be full of resentment, and I believed he had every right to feel that way.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Perhaps he had been putting on an act.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: An act?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Neuvillette and Vautrin had a close relationship as superior and subordinate. Vautrin must've known that the Chief Justice would make an impartial judgment.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Thus, the more resentment he displayed, the clearer it would be to those present that you were upholding justice.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And to those who had been sitting on the fence, Vautrin's act was a very meaningful one.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: That's all from me. Does anyone else have anything to say? Now's your chance.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I don't have anything to say — apart from expressing my gratitude, that is.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Well then, let us head back. No need to see us off.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Please take care.

talks.objective: Return to the Court of Fontaine

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Troubles are an inevitable part of life, but it seems like the Chief Justice has had more of them than most.

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: Recently, a criminal named Domenico attempted to incite the other criminals to rebel against Neuvillette.

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: We of the Mutual Aid Network couldn't just stand there and watch, so we stepped in and taught him a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon agrees with everything Wriothesley said.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #As Chief Justice, every single one of your trials makes an impact on Fontaine... What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Heyyy, {NICKNAME}! Any comments?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What I really think is...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Every trial you've ever judged has left its impression on you. And that's what makes you who you are today.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (As the Hydro Dragon Sovereign, Neuvillette still thinks of himself as an outsider due to his identity...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (But so much time has passed since then... Perhaps the lines between him and humans have long since blurred.)

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: ...That is indeed a reasonable assumption.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: As I said, I find it difficult to express my emotions... because I cannot fully understand myself.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: But I trust your judgment. Since some time ago, I've begun to notice the changes that have occurred upon my person.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: These changes were not due to any specific occurrence, but emerged as a result of time itself.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I will try to contemplate this further. Thank you both.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Is the matter resolved?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! We found the person who sent that threatening letter. Wriothesley told us he'd keep a close eye on him, so the Melusines should be safe now.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Oh, that's wonderful!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Sorry for dragging you all into this.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: There's no need to apologize.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Yeah, you didn't drag us in. We got involved of our own accord.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: By the way, where's Kiara?

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: At the Palais Mermonia. More than fifty people offered to protect her — some even hid within the bushes to look out for danger.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: I was worried that the excess of protection would make her feel uneasy, so I asked her to stay inside the Palais. It's very safe in there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew, what a relief!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Well now, it looks like the dust has finally settled!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: To celebrate this joyous occasion... Monsieur Neuvillette, would you be interested in an exclusive interview?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's not how you celebrate!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I will consider it.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: *gasp* Really!?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Of course. My schedule is full for the following weeks, but I should be available next month.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Come up with questions during the intervening days, and I will answer them to the best of my ability.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Yes! Thank you so much, Monsieur!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Now, if you'll excuse me, I must head back to the Palais and issue a communique to publicize our investigation results.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I hope it will assuage the concerns of all.

dialogues.speaker: Auriol
dialogues.text: I had many grievances about my situation before joining the network. I knew that I had committed crimes, yes, but that alone didn't stop life here from being miserable.

dialogues.speaker: Auriol
dialogues.text: But look at me now! Chatting with my friends, doing meaningful things together...

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Zzz...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Kiara?

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Ah, Monsieur Neuvillette? Sorry, I accidentally fell asleep.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: It's alright. I'm here to tell you that we've caught the sender of that threatening letter. You're safe now.

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Thank you, Monsieur.

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: #And thank you too, {NICKNAME} and Big Sis Paimon. Everyone's been so nice to me, so I've always felt really safe.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Do you remember Domenico? He was the sender of that letter.

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Let me think... I can't remember. My memory isn't that good, so I easily forget things...

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: By the way, I saw Carole in my dreams just now. Hmm... where's she gone, by the way? I haven't seen her in a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: In my dream, she looked really happy. She held my hand and said: "Kiara, our dreams have finally come true!"

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: I can't remember what our dreams were anymore, and I don't know why, but I felt really happy too.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I can sense your joy. It is indeed a delightful moment.

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Hehe... Monsieur Neuvillette, are you happy too?

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Ooh, I almost forgot! Am I allowed to go out now?

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: I promised to model for Eloffe!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Of course — off you go.

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: #See you next time, Monsieur, {NICKNAME}, and Big Sis Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Mm... See you next time.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Please escort the remaining guests back to the Fleuve Cendre. I appreciate your help!

dialogues.speaker: Tetreaux & Faustier
dialogues.text: Yes, boss.

dialogues.speaker: Oudinot
dialogues.text: Whew... That was a close call.

dialogues.speaker: Massena
dialogues.text: Are we really in the clear, though?

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Neuvillette made an appearance in person! This is the perfect chance to make a name for myself.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Hmm... But how should I make the most of this and get the word out...

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: Am I seeing things?

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: Eh, I must've been mistaken.

dialogues.speaker: Millereau
dialogues.text: Hmm? May I help you with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Auriol
dialogues.text: I'm Auriol, a member of the Mutual Aid Network. Is there something you need?

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: Anything you need?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The badge you're wearing...

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: Oh, this? Are you interested in joining the Mutual Aid Network?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Mutual Aid Network? Don't tell Paimon you're another shady organization like the Beret Society...

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: The Beret Society... Oh, you mean the group that was dissolved a while back? Rest assured, we're completely different.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay then. What does your network usually do?

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: We have a very long history, going back as far as four hundred years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: We have never had many members throughout our history, nor do we have much of a reputation... But everyone treats each other like family.

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: Helping each other is our purpose. At the same time, we seek to maintain just dealings as far much possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like a pretty neat organization!

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: Haha, all we want is to defend ourselves. None of us have ever committed serious crimes, and we're not especially powerful either. We're at a natural disadvantage here in the Fortress.

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: But people won't give us a hard time if we stick together.

dialogues.speaker: Millereau
dialogues.text: What do you think? Interested in joining?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: An exclusive interview! Am I dreaming...? What should I ask him?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Don't let anything hold you back. Make the most of this opportunity and ask away!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: I agree. He'll decline any question he can't answer anyway, so you might as well give all of them a shot.

dialogues.speaker: Livre
dialogues.text: Charlotte's voice never fails to carry through the walls. I have no idea what's going on, but it sounds like something good's happened.

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: Everyone seems to be in good spirits. This truly is a wonderful day...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I really can't fathom what goes on in her head sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: "Neuvillette's Note"
dialogues.text: "Away for personal reasons. Will be back in a day."

dialogues.speaker: Furina's Reply
dialogues.text: "'Personal reasons'? Oh me, oh my, has our Chief Justice finally come to his senses?"

dialogues.speaker: Furina's Reply
dialogues.text: "If I've told you once, I've told you a thousand times — You should follow my example and go out more often. You need to get to know your people better!"

dialogues.speaker: Furina's Reply
dialogues.text: "Even if something unfortunate happens, you'll still run into lots of unique characters along the way."

dialogues.speaker: Furina's Reply
dialogues.text: "What do you think? The human world isn't too bad, now is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I once thought that time was of no consequence to me.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Distance yourself from others and stay focused on your work. A few years or a few hundred... it's all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: But... after all this, I've realized that perhaps this way of thinking is fundamentally flawed.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The passing of time has its own consequences. The answer that I've been searching for amongst all those lives... perhaps it's life itself.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Please come with me to the infirmary.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Ah, and watch your step. There are some pretty dark areas, so make sure you don't trip over anything.

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: It's Monsieur Neuvillette!

dialogues.speaker: Gordes
dialogues.text: Did Neuvillette just walk by?

dialogues.speaker: Millereau
dialogues.text: We just had a new member join us last month...

dialogues.speaker: Auriol
dialogues.text: Now that I think about it, I can leave this place soon... Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should've gathered enough information! Let's head back and talk to Neuvillette!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: That trial is something I rarely bring up in conversation, but I've always felt deep regret for what happened to both Carole and Vautrin.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The words he spoke in court often replay in my mind, as if urging me on to do something...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Wriothesley said he never resented you, right? Isn't that a good thing?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I believe I now understand what he wanted to tell me.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I feel conflicted about those words. How should I describe it... Surprise, relief, fear, and regret... But this blend of emotions has led me to finally understand some things.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I would like to hear your thoughts, too. What do you think of me?

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Zzz...
